text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on follow through selling and position evening ahead of the weekend as traders watch weather on the Prairies. November WCE canola crush profit margins rose to -10.14 Thursday from -12.02 Wednesday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3802, rose to 84.22 yen and rose to 1.3295 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on spill over pressure.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on Thursday's Canadian Wheat Board Pool Return Outlook.
The CWB's world price forecast set a C$5 a tonne decline in feed barley values.
FEED WHEAT - C$1.00 to C$2.00 down on the CWB's July PROs which set a C$6 to C$9 a tonne fall in world wheat prices.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
